overview: The Commission discussed a variance request for the MBTA Wellington station redesign and planned for a disability resource fair and a new commission logo. Members also reviewed website updates and upcoming community events.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Postponed approval of the January minutes to the next meeting because several members were absent or had not yet reviewed the draft.

items.title: Wellington Station ADA Variance Request
items.summary: Discussed a request for an ADA variance regarding bathroom dimensions at Wellington station and decided to grant it with a recommendation that future major renovations prioritize full accessibility.

items.title: Commission Webpage Updates
items.summary: Frances Nwajei identified errors on the commission’s new city webpage, including missing member names and transportation resources that require restoration.

items.title: Logo Design and Community Outreach
items.summary: Planned a campaign to solicit designs for a new commission logo from high school students and local disability advocacy groups.

items.title: Disability Resource Fair Planning
items.summary: Discussed organizing a spring resource fair and assigned members to verify the availability and accessibility of the Brooks and Andrews school buildings as potential venues.

items.title: Regional Coordinating Council Update
items.summary: Received a brief report on an MBTA regional meeting and available training programs for individuals requesting paratransit rides.

items.title: New Business and Community Events
items.summary: Clarified that the commission's role is to provide resources rather than direct humanitarian aid and shared details on upcoming Black History Month events and Mass Office of Disability trainings.
